panoramic roof on the Panamera
models create particularly bright and
pleasant lighting.

front, while the rear section is a fixed
glass roof. Both glass surfaces feature
individual retractable shades.

against direct sunlight, the Panamera
Executive models feature power
sunblinds in the rear compartment,
and the Panamera 4S Executive variants
and up include the power sunblinds for
the rear side windows as well. The rear
windshield sunblind can be configured
to roll down automatically when reverse
gear is selected.
